seo.title: Lumière | Savor the Moment
seo.description: Discover carefully roasted specialty coffees and seasonal fresh flavors prepared with locally sourced ingredients at Lumière.

hero.description: A seasonal menu inspired by locally sourced ingredients, thoughtfully prepared and beautifully served.

brew.desc: Lumière serves more than just a great cup of coffee. We are a radically-inclusive café experience, serving everything from your morning espresso to your evening glass of wine. Inspired by the cafe culture, we are dedicated to local producers and artisans, and driven by our staff, customers, and community.

artisans.desc: Every sip and every bite at Lumière tells a story of our region. By partnering with passionate local farmers and sustainable producers, we ensure that you get the freshest flavors while supporting our community's growth.

study.desc: Lumière offers a serene environment for studying and working. With comfortable seating and a tranquil atmosphere, it's the ideal spot to immerse yourself in your tasks.

ourStory.subtitle: OUR STORY
paragraphs: At Lumière we believe a meal can tell much more than a recipe.

It all starts with a traditional approach handed down from generation to generation. A simple, delicate and carefully crafted preparation, inspired by those kitchens where the smell of fresh herbs is part of the memories.
That original recipe is the heart of LUMIÈRE.

ourStoryHero.description: The unique journey of passionately roasted coffee beans from the farm to your cup...

slides: We reinterpret traditions with modern touches. Discover our signature drinks prepared by blending classics with creativity.
Enjoy the natural freshness prepared with fresh fruits sourced from local producers, containing absolutely no syrups.
Witness how our carefully roasted beans turn into a work of art in the hands of our master baristas.
Our specialty coffees with intense aroma and smooth taste, served in special ceramic cups, await you.

testimonials.name: Ayşe Yılmaz
testimonials.note: Lavender Latte was the most balanced and soothing coffee I have ever had. Baristas are very smiling.

testimonials.name: Mehmet Demir
testimonials.note: Espresso Blends feels truly 'premium'. Interior design is very cozy but a bit crowded.

testimonials.name: Zeynep Kaya
testimonials.note: Croissants came out fresh in the morning, warm and crispy. Lumière became indispensable for my coffee ritual.

testimonials.name: Can Özkan
testimonials.note: Cold Brew bottle is very stylish, tasted good too but prices could be a bit more affordable.

reviewsHero.description: Read the stories and experiences of those who shared their moments with us at Lumière.

menuHero.description: Prepare yourself to savor the unforgettable moments at Lumière.

menu.description: Specialty espresso from Toma Café and Hola Coffee. Ceremonial-grade matcha. Real fruit, no syrups.

products.name: LATTE
products.description: Espresso with creamy steamed milk and soft latte art. Balanced, warm, and right for any moment.

products.name: CAPPUCCINO
products.description: Bold espresso under a creamy foam with a dusting of cocoa or cinnamon. Classic, elegant.

products.name: COCO MATCHA
products.description: Smooth, well-balanced Japanese matcha with creamy milk. Refreshing, delicate, and perfect.

products.name: BUTTER CROISSANT
products.description: Flaky, golden, and baked fresh every morning with pure French butter.

products.name: COLD BREW BOTTLE
products.description: 12-hour steeped signature blend, ready to drink on the move.
